description: Ministry of Justice and Prison Reforms - Order under section 4 & 9 of the Mutual Assistance  Civil and Commercial Matters Act, No. 39 of 2000
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters. It contains orders made under the Mutual Assistance in Civil and Commercial Matters Act, No. 39 of 2000, declaring the application of specific provisions to countries party to international conventions. While it mentions a minister's name (Thalatha Atukorale), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make legal declarations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about legal frameworks, international treaties, and regulatory compliance, fitting Type 5 criteria for legal/regulatory matters.
